dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 20, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Dominant Performances Highlight MLB Action**

Trevor Larnach and Byron Buxton led the Minnesota Twins' offense with multiple hits, but it wasn't enough as the Cleveland Guardians cruised to a 13-4 victory. Petey Halpin stole the show with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs for the Guardians.

Jazz Chisholm Jr. hit 2 home runs and drove in 5 runs to power the New York Yankees to a 8-5 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Wilber Dotel struck out 5 in 3 scoreless innings for the Yankees.

Dylan Cease tossed 6 strong innings and Nick Fortes hit a home run to lead the Tampa Bay Rays to a 7-1 win over the Toronto Blue Jays.

Trea Turner hit 2 home runs and drove in 5 runs to pace the Philadelphia Phillies to a 10-7 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers, while Cristopher Sánchez earned the win with 5.1 strong innings.

Ty France hit a home run to lead the Atlanta Braves to a 3-2 win over the San Diego Padres.

Dillon Dingler hit 2 home runs and drove in 3 runs to pace the Detroit Tigers to an 8-6 win over the Chicago Cubs.

Yordan Alvarez hit 2 home runs to power the Houston Astros to an 8-5 win over the Miami Marlins.

Cal Raleigh hit a home run and drove in 5 runs to pace the Seattle Mariners to an 8-0 win over the Cincinnati Reds.

Ketel Marte hit a home run to lead the Athletics to a 5-2 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.

George Kirby threw 6 scoreless innings to lead the Seattle Mariners to an 8-0 win over the Cincinnati Reds.

Jo Adell hit a home run to pace the Los Angeles Angels to a 3-2 win over the St. Louis Cardinals.
